hook: Fifteen questions, no second chances. Can you score fifteen out of fifteen? Let us find out.

questions.question: Which layer of the Earth do we live on?
questions.question_speech: Question one. Which layer of the Earth do we live on? A. Mantle. B. Crust. C. Outer core. D. Inner core.

questions.question: What is the main cause of ocean tides?
questions.question_speech: Question two. What is the main cause of ocean tides? A. The Moon's gravity. B. Wind. C. Earth's rotation only. D. Ocean currents.
questions.answer_speech: A is correct, the Moon's gravity.

questions.question: What is a large rotating tropical storm called?
questions.question_speech: Question three. What is a large rotating tropical storm called? A. Tornado. B. Blizzard. C. Hurricane. D. Drought.

questions.question: Which layer of the atmosphere protects us from harmful ultraviolet rays?
questions.question_speech: Question four. Which layer of the atmosphere protects us from harmful ultraviolet rays? A. Ozone layer. B. Ionosphere. C. Exosphere. D. Troposphere.
questions.answer_speech: A is correct, the ozone layer.

questions.question: About how long does the Earth take to orbit the Sun?
questions.question_speech: Question five. About how long does the Earth take to orbit the Sun? A. About 30 days. B. About 365 days. C. About 24 hours. D. About 180 days.

questions.question: Which continent is the coldest?
questions.question_speech: Question six. Which continent is the coldest? A. Arctic. B. Asia. C. Antarctica. D. Europe.

questions.question: Which instrument measures air pressure?
questions.question_speech: Question seven. Which instrument measures air pressure? A. Thermometer. B. Anemometer. C. Seismograph. D. Barometer.

questions.question: What type of rock forms from cooled lava or magma?
questions.question_speech: Question eight. What type of rock forms from cooled lava or magma? A. Sedimentary. B. Igneous. C. Metamorphic. D. Fossil.

questions.question: What mainly causes earthquakes?
questions.question_speech: Question nine. What mainly causes earthquakes? A. Moving tectonic plates. B. Strong winds. C. The Moon. D. Heavy rain.
questions.answer_speech: A is correct, moving tectonic plates.

questions.question: What was the name of the single giant landmass that once joined all the continents?
questions.question_speech: Question ten. What was the name of the single giant landmass that once joined all the continents? A. Atlantis. B. Gondwana. C. Pangaea. D. Laurasia.

questions.question: Rainbows form when sunlight passes through what?
questions.question_speech: Question eleven. Rainbows form when sunlight passes through what? A. Clouds of dust. B. Water droplets. C. Snow crystals. D. Smoke.

questions.question: Which layer of the Earth is the largest by volume?
questions.question_speech: Question twelve. Which layer of the Earth is the largest by volume? A. Crust. B. Outer core. C. Inner core. D. Mantle.

questions.question: Which instrument measures earthquakes?
questions.question_speech: Question thirteen. Which instrument measures earthquakes? A. Seismograph. B. Barometer. C. Hygrometer. D. Telescope.

questions.question: About how long does the Earth take to rotate once on its axis?
questions.question_speech: Question fourteen. About how long does the Earth take to rotate once on its axis? A. About 12 hours. B. About 24 hours. C. About 48 hours. D. About 7 days.

questions.question: What do we call the water that falls from clouds?
questions.question_speech: Question fifteen. What do we call the water that falls from clouds? A. Evaporation. B. Condensation. C. Precipitation. D. Erosion.
